resources.string: Lets Faze notice the two volume buttons held together, so you can open its overlay from any app. It also notices when Google\'s assistant window opens (by its name only) so Faze can take over. By default it does not read the screen. Only when you switch on "Allow screen view and control" does it use touch gestures, the back, home and recents buttons, text entry and screenshots, so a paired device can control this phone without root.
